newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Liz Claiborne rating affirmed.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Liz Claiborne rating affirmed.

text.p: -- Rodman & Renshaw Inc Tuesday affirmed its buy rating for Liz Claiborne Inc, citing a recent Wall Street Journal story in which the company said it posted excellent holiday retail sales.

-- Rodman said the company is positioned to sustain solid double-digit earnings growth. Rodman's estimate for fiscal 1997 remains at $2.45 per share, while the estimate for fiscal 1998 remains at $2.85 per share.
-- Rodman's fourth quarter 1996 earnings estimate remains at $0.52, compared to $0.45 in the fourth quarter of 1995. Rodman's estimate for 1996 remains at $2.10, versus $1.69 in 1995.
-- Liz Claiborne is expected to release 1996 results February 18.
-- Liz Claiborne makes men's and women's apparel.
